en.title: Construct New Array
en.description: Build a new array by taking, in order, the leftmost element of the original array, then the rightmost, the second from the left, the second from the right, and so on.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤100000), and the second line contains n integers (−10^9≤a[i]≤10^9).
en.output: Output the n integers in construction order.
en.explanation: Derive the linear scan/dynamic programming solution directly from the rules of the problem; the examples have been checked one by one against an independently built oracle.
hints: First turn the operations or constraints in the statement into a definite array/state transition, then analyze the boundaries.
